description: Return what the design deviance score may do on its own for one project: threshold (0–100; the actions fire above it), failCi (mushi recipe check --push fails CI above it), autofix (new warn/error findings above it dispatch a fix) and autofixEnabled (the project auto-fix switch, without which the design auto-fix does nothing), plus canEdit. Optional projectId. Read-only.

projectId.description: Project UUID — defaults to the server-configured project when omitted (`project_id` is accepted too.)

name: get_design_settings
title: Design score actions
